verdict: INGREDIENTS: no recombination of these terms beats the vegetation null out-of-sample, so the shortfall is not a weighting problem. The physics is missing a driver, and reweighting would only refit vegetation under another name.
coefficient_caveat: solar_albedo and veg terms correlate at +0.02/+0.32/+0.09 across the three wards, so individual coefficients can trade off and a surprising sign is a lead, not a finding. The out-of-sample r values are the result.
